FacultyScoreBinding.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/faculty-score.ts:47. Runtime binding, not a downloaded file; kept so the schema covers every exported type of the in-scope files.

rubric.description: Server rubric, or null when scoring is disabled.

scenarioRubrics.description: TypeScript Map<string, ReviewRubricItem[]>; serialised as a JSON object keyed by scenario id.

scoreDir.description: Score directory, or null when scoring is disabled.

FacultyScoreFile.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/faculty-score.ts:67. Persisted faculty score file, review-safe: no session id, no timestamps, no labels.

scenarioId.description: Present only on scores written against a scenarios bank; absent on C13 single-rubric scores.

LobbyScore.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/faculty-score.ts:59. One lobby score badge for a station with a score file on disk.

items.description: Per-item flags in rubric order, from the same validated score file.

ReplayReviewState.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/faculty-score.ts:301. Narrow replay-room state surface the C13 review handler mutates; the learners map is a runtime method surface, not a JSON value.

learners.description: Runtime lookup learners.get(id) -> { lastSeq } | undefined; not a JSON value.

ReplayRoomGuard.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/review-packet.ts:287. Per-replay-room C14 guard: a lobby is launched back at most once.

ReviewPacketFile.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/review-packet-file.ts:20. Persisted faculty review packet, review-safe: no identity, no labels, no timestamps.

ReviewPacketStation.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/review-packet-file.ts:9. One packet station row: the index row plus note text and the score.

noteText.description: Patient-note file text when the station noted, else null.

ReviewRubricItem.description: Source: packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-server/src/faculty-score.ts:39. One rubric checklist entry (server config only).

requiredTraceTags.description: C21/C22 scenario-bank trace requirements; absent on the C13 server rubric.
